capabilities: Switch between Seasoned (markers visible), Rendered (WYSIWYG), and Plain (raw) editing modes on the same file
Indent with Tab using a tab-vs-space ruler
Drag sections in the table of contents to move them in the note
Pause re-highlighting during IME composition so CJK input is uninterrupted
extras: Published by CVER Inc. (cver.net) under MIT license; makes no network requests and collects no telemetry; beta builds are available via BRAT (CVERInc/obsidian-marktile).
problem: Obsidian's editor only toggles between source mode and Live Preview; it doesn't let you keep Markdown markers on screen while headings still render large, or offer per-session choices between the two.

relations.evidence: Sister plugin: tugtile — a card table for your Markdown notes; marktile is its editor

summary: A Markdown editor pane with three switchable modes — markers visible, full WYSIWYG, and raw — plus smart list continuation and a drag-reorderable table of contents.
